title: An AI-Powered Augmentative and Alternative Communication (AAC) tool
summary: AI4Africa proposes speech-to-speech assistance for people with communication disabilities and names Limi Hospital as a testbed.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: The proposed augmentative and alternative communication tool would transform difficult-to-understand speech into clearer output. Limi Hospital is named as a testbed, while the technical development is described as future work. The intended benefit is greater communication independence. The source does not document restored communication for a user.
purpose: Support communication for people with speech disabilities.

ratings.reason: Limi Hospital is named as a testbed, but the text proposes an AAC tool and documents no restored communication for an individual.
Social inclusion is a projected effect of communication support.

ai_role.statement: The contributor describes the system and its proposed or reported contribution. This collection entry does not independently isolate the effect of AI from the surrounding workflow.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
evidence.title: Use Case 20: An AI-Powered Augmentative and Alternative Communication (AAC) tool

produced_by: The contributor describes the application and its setting in the cited entry. Conditions sufficient to reproduce the reported benefit have not been established.
must_hold: Requirements for reproducing the benefit need to be evaluated in the new setting. The collection entry does not establish that its reported results will recur.

headline: An AAC proposal aims to turn impaired speech into clear speech
